-- Inert source fixture: the .fixture.txt suffix keeps it out of VMB bundles.
local function configure_living_outfit(owner_unit, outfit_unit)
    Unit.enable_animation_state_machine(outfit_unit)
    local counted, num_meshes = pcall(Unit.num_meshes, owner_unit)
    if not counted or not num_meshes or num_meshes <= 0 then
        num_meshes = 24
    end
    for mesh_index = 0, num_meshes - 1 do
        Unit.set_mesh_visibility(owner_unit, mesh_index, false, "default")
    end
end

local WARLOCK_RAGDOLL_SAMPLE_TIMES_MS = { 0, 100, 5000 }

local function warlock_rigid_world_pose(unit, node)
    return Matrix4x4.from_quaternion_position(
        Unit.world_rotation(unit, node), Unit.world_position(unit, node))
end

local function apply_warlock_death_pose(driver)
    local desired_worlds = {}
    for i, pair in ipairs(driver.node_pairs) do
        local source_world = warlock_rigid_world_pose(driver.owner, pair.source)
        local source_delta = Matrix4x4.multiply(
            pair.source_world_inverse_at_handoff:unbox(), source_world)
        desired_worlds[i] = Matrix4x4.multiply(
            pair.target_world_at_handoff:unbox(), source_delta)
    end

    for i, pair in ipairs(driver.node_pairs) do
        local parent_world = desired_worlds[pair.parent_pair]
        local desired_local = Matrix4x4.multiply(
            desired_worlds[i], Matrix4x4.inverse(parent_world))
        Unit.set_local_rotation(driver.outfit, pair.target,
            Matrix4x4.rotation(desired_local))
        if pair.is_hips then
            Unit.set_local_position(driver.outfit, pair.target,
                Matrix4x4.translation(desired_local))
        end
    end

    printf("[doomrocket:RAGDOLL] phase=sample id=%s source=%s checkpoint_ms=%d elapsed_ms=%d wall_gap_ms=%.1f owner_alive=true outfit_alive=true nodes=%d custom_actors=0 carrier_reveals=0 parent_mismatch=0 root_delta=%.3f hips_delta=%.3f hips_drift=%.3f scale_mutations=0 nonhips_translation_mutations=0 bounds_ratio=%.3f max_bone_radius_ratio=%.3f",
        driver.id, driver.source, checkpoint, driver.elapsed_ms, wall_gap,
        #driver.node_pairs, root_delta, hips_delta, hips_drift, bounds_ratio,
        max_bone_radius_ratio)
end

mod._warlock_active_death_drivers = setmetatable({}, { __mode = "k" })

local function queue_warlock_death_pose(driver)
    if driver.callback_pending then
        return
    end

    local animation_system = Managers.state.entity:system("animation_system")
    driver.callback_pending = true
    animation_system:add_safe_animation_callback(function()
        driver.callback_pending = false
        if not driver.stopped then
            apply_warlock_death_pose(driver)
        end
    end)
end

local function queue_active_warlocks_for_world(world)
    for driver in pairs(mod._warlock_active_death_drivers) do
        local owner = driver.owner
        if owner and Unit.alive(owner) and Unit.world(owner) == world then
            queue_warlock_death_pose(driver)
        end
    end
end

mod:hook_safe(World, "update_animations", function(world)
    queue_active_warlocks_for_world(world)
end)

mod:hook_safe(World, "update_animations_with_callback", function(world)
    queue_active_warlocks_for_world(world)
end)

mod._prepare_warlock_death = function(owner_unit, source)
    local outfit_unit = mod._warlock_outfits[owner_unit]
    Unit.set_animation_bone_mode(outfit_unit, "ignore")
    local source_world_at_handoff = warlock_rigid_world_pose(owner_unit, source_hips)
    local pair = {
        source_world_at_handoff = Matrix4x4Box(source_world_at_handoff),
        source_world_inverse_at_handoff = Matrix4x4Box(
            Matrix4x4.inverse(source_world_at_handoff)),
        target_world_at_handoff = Matrix4x4Box(
            Unit.world_pose(outfit_unit, target_hips)),
    }
    local driver = {
        id = id,
        source = source,
        owner = owner_unit,
        outfit = outfit_unit,
        node_pairs = { pair },
        callback_pending = false,
    }
    mod._warlock_active_death_drivers[driver] = true
    printf("[doomrocket:RAGDOLL] phase=begin id=%s source=%s elapsed_ms=0", id, source)
    return driver
end

local function stop_driver(driver)
    mod._warlock_active_death_drivers[driver] = nil
    printf("[doomrocket:RAGDOLL] phase=stop id=%s source=%s elapsed_ms=%d",
        driver.id, driver.source, driver.elapsed_ms)
end
